<a id="required-organization-under-whole-generative-comparison--完整生成比较下的组织形成要求"></a>
# Required organization under whole generative comparison

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`organizational-formation-from-generative-comparison` · **reviewed-scoped** · argument · F07 · [record](organizational-formation-from-generative-comparison.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> In a finite nonempty eligible range, if every continuation lacking an organizational relation has a strictly better eligible construction, every undefeated choice includes that relation. This can warrant building or strengthening shared capacity without fixing one carrier.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- G0, explicit J1–J4 and complete relational correspondence; ethics is not deduced from monism alone.
- A finite nonempty eligible range, irreflexive transitive comparison and actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case; normative eligibility and basic classifications require substantive warrant.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- General generative structure does not supply full basic-content correspondence for unfamiliar new living.
- The requirement does not establish inevitable compliance.
- It does not derive complete institutional authority.
- **Counterexample:** Overbuilding actually depletes the living basis; identical construction reports fail to classify it. Faithful retained-amount information repairs this local omission. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RelationalOrganization.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** Premise-free (zero-substantive-axiom) grounding is a separate open target; completed results on the conditional alignment route keep their scope.

<a id="progress--已接通"></a>
## Progress

1. Monist reconstruction: organizational appraisal starts from one generative history; living significance supplies positive significance, the commitments of comparison and basic-condition priority scoped comparative force, and finite scope a nonempty undefeated range. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ETHICAL-LEARNING-INTEGRATION.md#74-the-affirmative-philosophical-proof-and-its-exact-normative-strength)
2. Checked composition: practical judgment's undefeated range and dominance exclusion yield the formation requirement; a worked history requires a coordinating function that either of two carriers can bear. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ETHICAL-LEARNING-INTEGRATION.md#75-mathematical-correspondence-inheritance-and-actual-checks)
3. Tested limit: the overbuilding history is kept and the construction-report omission repaired; organizational necessity, more structure or present recognition do not supply the basic content of unfamiliar new living. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ETHICAL-LEARNING-INTEGRATION.md#78-the-tested-limit-and-current-status)
4. Robust classification: formation requirements also follow in a class of unsettled-basic-status cases (classification-robust-generative-comparison). [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ETHICAL-LEARNING-INTEGRATION.md#79-updated-repository-continuation-identity-and-exact-delta)

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

13 new Lean theorem declarations/29 declaration audits, with 30 inherited theorems/46 audits separately rebuilt. Includes applications and a definitional identity, not 13 normative-axiom proofs. Author counterreview; no independent-agent acceptance. No empirical validation.

Canonical source: [ETHICAL-LEARNING.md](../../chapters/ETHICAL-LEARNING.md)

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

Reuse robust classification. Where living-role classification changes implementation, establish decision-relevant substantive correspondence without requiring classification of all unfamiliar living before construction.
